name: crew
description: Reviews by other harnesses' models (Codex, Antigravity) and Claude, under one tool with enforced read limits

codex_bin.title: Codex CLI
codex_bin.description: Command or absolute path of the Codex CLI

agy_bin.title: Antigravity CLI
agy_bin.description: Command or absolute path of the Antigravity CLI

reviewers.title: Default reviewers
reviewers.description: Providers a review runs when the call names none: codex, antigravity, claude

codex_model.title: Codex model
codex_model.description: Model a Codex reviewer runs when the call names none; empty for Codex's default

codex_effort.title: Codex reasoning effort
codex_effort.description: Reasoning effort a Codex reviewer runs at when the call names none; empty for the model's default

agy_model.title: Antigravity model
agy_model.description: Model id an Antigravity reviewer runs when the call names none; empty for Antigravity's default

agy_effort.title: Antigravity effort
agy_effort.description: Effort an Antigravity reviewer runs at when the call names none; empty for the model's default

claude_model.title: Claude reviewer model
claude_model.description: sonnet, opus or haiku: the Claude reviewer's model when the call names none

claude_effort.title: Claude reviewer effort
claude_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max for every Claude reviewer; empty for the session's effort

reviewer_rules.title: Reviewer rule files
reviewer_rules.description: Absolute paths of Markdown files added to every reviewer's instructions

timeout_s.title: Reviewer timeout (s)
timeout_s.description: How long one reviewer may run before it is stopped
